name: ACT tertiary concession (MyWay+)
summary: Concession fares on Canberra buses and light rail for full-time university and CIT students.
who: Full-time students at a public or private Australian university, or at CIT.
how: In your MyWay+ account, choose Register concession, pick Concession as the fare type, then your concession type.
Or order a concession card in your account, or buy one at a MyWay+ retail outlet.
need: ID showing you study full-time, such as a valid student card. Carry it whenever you travel.
catches: Tertiary concessions expire on 31 March of the year after purchase, so revalidate each year.
The account and concession must be in your own name.
